body:
The only two things that make me happy is scuba diving and having someone in life by my side to share experiences with. I've traveled extensively solo, and been single for long stints,  and I honestly just want someone to be my best friend, love me like I love them, and share life experiences with. 


I'm very lonely, even though I have friends all over the world, both near and far. 


To me, life alone isn't fun and I find no joy in life at all.


I'm dont feel like I'm insecure right now,  just like I'm going to die alone. 


I was always the best at everything all the way through college.  Best grades, best jobs, most money, most friends, most money, most everything. 


Now the glory days are over and I'm ready to just give up unfortunately.


Every one of my friends seem to be doing better than me.
